omittedResponsibilities: Root writeTempFile/commit/transfer/ConnectTo, full services/transactions/encryption/model/filter/UI and source full package QA remain unfinished. Empty/legacy manifest export, physical native ABI/allocator/thread/fatal domains remain unqualified.

stackDivergence.rationale: Existing actual SAL/CPPU logical addresses, compiler specialization/interface casts and explicit scope destruction bind native C++ syntax. The actual pinned SDK libc++ mutex implements the original member and guard lifetimes; native pthread/physical C++ ABI remain unqualified.

filenameDivergence.rationale: Original ZipPackage.cxx combines tree/service ownership and three metadata-entry output responsibilities. The split preserves the1000-line source budget without a second package or replacement provider.
